"""Build the US macro workbook (unemployment vs CPI) from the NWDATA CSVs in data/."""
import csv
import sys
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from openpyxl import Workbook
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, LineChart, Reference
from openpyxl.chart.shapes import GraphicalProperties
from openpyxl.chart.text import RichText
from openpyxl.drawing.text import CharacterProperties, Paragraph, ParagraphProperties
from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Border, Font, PatternFill, Side

ROOT = Path(__file__).parent
OUT = ROOT / "econ_data_unemployment_cpi.xlsx"
LINE_TITLE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "Jobs vs Prices: US Unemployment & CPI (CPI through Sep 2026)"

BG, PANEL, GRID, TEXT, MUTED = "0B0E11", "161A1E", "2B3139", "EAECEF", "848E9C"
CYAN, ORANGE = "00E5FF", "F7931A"


def load(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        rows = list(csv.reader(f))[1:]
    return {date.fromisoformat(d): float(v) for d, v in rows if v not in ("", ".")}


nwunemp = load(ROOT / "data/nwunemp.csv")
cpi = load(ROOT / "data/cpi.csv")
observed = sorted(set(nwunemp) | set(cpi))
# one row per calendar month so 12-row lookbacks stay aligned across NWDATA gaps
months = [date(y, m, 1) for y in range(observed[0].year, observed[-1].year + 1) for m in range(1, 13)
          if observed[0] <= date(y, m, 1) <= observed[-1]]
years = sorted({m.year for m in months})

wb = Workbook()
fill = lambda c: PatternFill("solid", fgColor=c)
border = Border(bottom=Side(style="thin", color=GRID))


def paint(ws, ncols, nrows):
    ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=nrows + 40, max_col=ncols + 12):
        for c in row:
            c.fill = fill(BG)
            c.font = Font(name="Consolas", color=TEXT)


# Data sheet
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Data"
headers = ["Date", "Year", "Unemployment %", "CPI (1982-84=100)", "CPI YoY %", "Unemp Δ 12m (pp)"]
n = len(months)
paint(ws, len(headers), n + 2)
for i, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    c = ws.cell(1, i, h)
    c.font = Font(name="Consolas", bold=True, color=ORANGE)
    c.fill = fill(PANEL)
    c.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
for r, m in enumerate(months, 2):
    ws.cell(r, 1, m).number_format = "yyyy-mm"
    ws.cell(r, 2, f"=YEAR(A{r})")
    if m in nwunemp:
        ws.cell(r, 3, nwunemp[m]).number_format = "0.0"
    if m in cpi:
        ws.cell(r, 4, cpi[m]).number_format = "0.000"
    if r >= 14:
        ws.cell(r, 5, f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(D{r}),ISNUMBER(D{r-12})),D{r}/D{r-12}-1,"")').number_format = "0.00%"
        ws.cell(r, 6, f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(C{r}),ISNUMBER(C{r-12})),C{r}-C{r-12},"")').number_format = "+0.0;-0.0;0.0"
    for col in (3, 4):
        ws.cell(r, col).font = Font(name="Consolas", color=CYAN if col == 3 else ORANGE)
    for col in range(1, 7):
        ws.cell(r, col).border = border
ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
for col, w in zip("ABCDEF", (10, 7, 16, 18, 11, 17)):
    ws.column_dimensions[col].width = w

# Yearly averages (formula-driven) + KPI strip, on the Charts sheet
cs = wb.create_sheet("Charts")
paint(cs, 30, 60)
cs.column_dimensions["A"].width = 8
for col in "BCD":
    cs.column_dimensions[col].width = 15
cs["A1"] = "US MACRO // UNEMPLOYMENT x CPI"
cs["A1"].font = Font(name="Consolas", bold=True, size=16, color=ORANGE)
last = n + 1
kpis = [
    ("Latest unemp %", f"=LOOKUP(2,1/ISNUMBER(Data!C2:C{last}),Data!C2:C{last})", "0.0"),
    ("Peak unemp %", f"=MAX(Data!C2:C{last})", "0.0"),
    ("Latest CPI", f"=LOOKUP(2,1/ISNUMBER(Data!D2:D{last}),Data!D2:D{last})", "0.0"),
    ("Peak CPI YoY", f"=MAX(Data!E2:E{last})", "0.0%"),
]
for i, (label, f, fmt) in enumerate(kpis):
    col = 1 + i * 2
    cs.cell(3, col, label).font = Font(name="Consolas", size=9, color=MUTED)
    v = cs.cell(4, col, f)
    v.number_format = fmt
    v.font = Font(name="Consolas", bold=True, size=14, color=CYAN if i < 2 else ORANGE)

t0 = 7
cs.cell(t0, 1, "Year").font = Font(name="Consolas", bold=True, color=ORANGE)
cs.cell(t0, 2, "Avg Unemp %").font = Font(name="Consolas", bold=True, color=CYAN)
cs.cell(t0, 3, "")  # blank spacer series keeps the dual-axis bars side by side
cs.cell(t0, 4, "Avg CPI").font = Font(name="Consolas", bold=True, color=ORANGE)
for i, y in enumerate(years, t0 + 1):
    cs.cell(i, 1, y)
    cs.cell(i, 2, f'=IFERROR(AVERAGEIFS(Data!C$2:C${last},Data!B$2:B${last},A{i}),"")').number_format = "0.00"
    cs.cell(i, 4, f'=IFERROR(AVERAGEIFS(Data!D$2:D${last},Data!B$2:B${last},A{i}),"")').number_format = "0.0"
t1 = t0 + len(years)


def style_chart(ch, title):
    ch.title = title
    ch.style = 2
    ch.graphical_properties = GraphicalProperties(solidFill=PANEL, ln=None)
    ch.plot_area.graphicalProperties = GraphicalProperties(solidFill=PANEL)
    tp = CharacterProperties(solidFill=TEXT, sz=1000, latin=None)
    ch.title.tx.rich.p[0].pPr = ParagraphProperties(defRPr=CharacterProperties(solidFill=TEXT, sz=1400, b=True))
    ch.legend.position = "b"
    ch.legend.txPr = RichText(p=[Paragraph(pPr=ParagraphProperties(defRPr=tp), endParaRPr=tp)])


def style_axis(ax, title, color):
    ax.title = title
    ax.delete = False
    cp = CharacterProperties(solidFill=color, sz=900)
    ax.txPr = RichText(p=[Paragraph(pPr=ParagraphProperties(defRPr=cp), endParaRPr=cp)])
    ax.majorGridlines = None


def color_series(s, hexcolor, line=True):
    if line:
        s.graphicalProperties.line.solidFill = hexcolor
        s.graphicalProperties.line.width = 22000
        s.smooth = False
    else:
        s.graphicalProperties.solidFill = hexcolor
        s.graphicalProperties.line.noFill = True


# Dual-axis line chart
dates = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=2, max_row=last)
lc = LineChart()
lc.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=3, min_row=1, max_row=last), titles_from_data=True)
lc.set_categories(dates)
color_series(lc.series[0], CYAN)
style_axis(lc.y_axis, "Unemployment %", CYAN)
style_axis(lc.x_axis, None, MUTED)
lc.x_axis.number_format = "yyyy"
lc.x_axis.majorTimeUnit = "years"
lc.x_axis.tickLblSkip = 12
lc.x_axis.tickMarkSkip = 12
lc.y_axis.majorGridlines = None
lc2 = LineChart()
lc2.add_data(Reference(ws, min_col=4, min_row=1, max_row=last), titles_from_data=True)
color_series(lc2.series[0], ORANGE)
lc2.y_axis.axId = 200
lc2.y_axis.crosses = "max"
style_axis(lc2.y_axis, "CPI index", ORANGE)
lc += lc2
style_chart(lc, LINE_TITLE)
lc.width, lc.height = 30, 12
cs.add_chart(lc, "F3")

# Yearly averages bar chart (unemployment on primary axis, CPI on secondary)
cats = Reference(cs, min_col=1, min_row=t0 + 1, max_row=t1)
bc = BarChart()
bc.type = "col"
bc.add_data(Reference(cs, min_col=2, max_col=3, min_row=t0, max_row=t1), titles_from_data=True)
bc.set_categories(cats)
color_series(bc.series[0], CYAN, line=False)
style_axis(bc.y_axis, "Avg unemployment %", CYAN)
style_axis(bc.x_axis, None, MUTED)
bc2 = BarChart()
bc2.type = "col"
bc2.add_data(Reference(cs, min_col=3, max_col=4, min_row=t0, max_row=t1), titles_from_data=True)
color_series(bc2.series[1], ORANGE, line=False)
bc2.y_axis.axId = 200
bc2.y_axis.crosses = "max"
style_axis(bc2.y_axis, "Avg CPI", ORANGE)
bc += bc2
style_chart(bc, "Yearly Averages")
bc.width, bc.height = 30, 11
cs.add_chart(bc, "F28")

wb.save(OUT)
print(f"wrote {OUT} | {n} months {months[0]:%Y-%m}..{months[-1]:%Y-%m} | nwunemp {len(nwunemp)} cpi {len(cpi)}")
